subject: Rolling PO setup, invoice pacing, and discount options for ZenMedCo
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <procurement@zenmedco.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: kevin.oneil@zenmedco.com
Date: 2026-11-30T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor setup: PO splitting, quarterly invoices, and net-45 terms

Hi Marissa,

We're preparing to onboard Redwood for a multi-product deployment across our clinical analytics teams. A couple of procurement items we need confirmation on before we proceed:

- ZenMedCo requires the ability to issue multiple POs across the fiscal year (we typically issue one PO per quarter/project). Can Redwood accept multiple active POs against one master account and ensure each invoice records the PO number(s) at the line level?
- Preferred invoice cadence is quarterly consolidated invoices but with PO references visible on each line item.
- Standard payment terms at ZenMedCo are Net-60, however we can consider Net-45 for strategic vendors. Can Redwood accept Net-60 or Net-45?
- We also need W-9 and COI as part of vendor setup; I've attached our vendor requirements document for reference.

Please let me know if any of this is a blocker. If there are discounts or packaging changes tied to annual committed spend that would affect invoice cadence (e.g., prepay vs. monthly/quarterly billing), include that in your response.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
ZenMedCo

Attachment: zenmedco_vendor_requirements.pdf (policy doc, 230KB)

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <procurement@zenmedco.com>
Cc: Kevin O'Neil <kevin.oneil@zenmedco.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO splitting, quarterly invoices, and net-45 terms

Hi Elena — thanks for the clarity and the vendor packet. Looping in our finance and sales for specifics but high level:

- Multiple POs: Yes, we can accept multiple active POs on one account. We can include PO numbers on every invoice line.
- Invoice cadence: Quarterly consolidated invoices are fine; we can produce a single quarterly invoice that lists line-level PO numbers, or we can issue separate invoices per PO if that is required by your AP practice.
- Net terms: Our standard enterprise terms are Net-45. Net-60 requires CFO approval and is uncommon for new accounts.
- Discounts & packaging: Discounts typically apply when the customer commits to annual reserved capacity (Dedicated) or prepays. For example, annual prepay gives the largest discount; quarterly prepay gives a smaller discount. I'll attach a short pricing summary showing the delta.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll attach a draft invoice template and a pricing summary for the options (annual prepay vs. quarterly billing with a committed discount).
2) Please confirm whether you need consolidated invoice per quarter or separate PO-level invoices.
3) Send a sample PO (or your PO template) so we can ensure our invoice fields map correctly.

I'll also loop finance internally for any early-payment discount options.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RWI-zenmedco-pricing-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), RWI-invoice-template-zenmedco.pdf (invoice template)

-----
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: ZenMedCo PO / terms negotiation

Marissa — quick internal note on levers we can use:

- If they sign an annual committed Dedicated reservation and prepay, we can do up to 5% off list. That would also make billing simple (single annual invoice with PO ref).
- For quarterly billing with commitment (but not prepay), consider 2% off invoice value.
- If they push for Net-60, we should escalate — ask for a 1.5% surcharge for extended terms or negotiate a small early-pay discount for Net-45 vs Net-60.
- Finance (Lauren): can we bake in an early-pay discount matrix (Net-30 => 2%, Net-45 => 1%, Net-60 => 0%)? That gives their AP options.

Connor — can you own the commercial language for PO acceptance and confirm whether we can accept up to 4 active POs per fiscal year on one subscription?

Thanks,
Ben

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <procurement@zenmedco.com>
Cc: Kevin O'Neil <kevin.oneil@zenmedco.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T14:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO splitting, quarterly invoices, and net-45 terms

Elena — following up with a concrete proposal and the invoice template attached. Summary below:

Proposal summary (variant A and B):
- Variant A (Quarterly billing, no prepay): Quarterly consolidated invoice that lists all PO numbers at the line level. Standard payment terms Net-45. Commercial discount: 2% off quarterly invoice if ZenMedCo signs a 12-month committed capacity agreement (quarterly invoiced, not prepaid).
- Variant B (Annual prepay): Single annual invoice, full prepay at signature => 5% discount. PO can reference the annual PO number; we will mark it on the invoice.

Other items:
- We can accept multiple POs — recommended operational limit: up to 6 POs per subscription per fiscal year to keep reconciliation manageable. If you need more, we'll map to project codes on the invoice.
- We will include PO number, PO line, billing address, and your project code fields on the invoice (please provide a sample PO).
- Net-60: requires escalation to our CFO; not approved by default. If Net-60 is required, we will request a short payment protection/credit check and may apply adjusted pricing.

Attached: RWI-invoice-template-zenmedco.pdf and the pricing summary. If this looks good, I can generate an updated quote with the agreed discount level and send the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RWI-invoice-template-zenmedco.pdf

On Tue, Nov 30, 2026 at 08:12 AM Elena Ruiz <procurement@zenmedco.com> wrote:
> Hi Marissa,
> 
> We're preparing to onboard Redwood... (original message follows)

-----
From: Elena Ruiz <procurement@zenmedco.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-03T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO splitting, quarterly invoices, and net-45 terms

Marissa — thanks for the options. A few clarifications from our side:

- ZenMedCo strongly prefers Net-60, but we can accept Net-45 if Redwood is willing to provide a 1.5% discount on quarterly invoices (this is to offset our working capital constraints).
- Our AP requires PO-level detail including: PO number, billing address, project code, and a reference to the master agreement number.
- Attached is our PO template — please confirm the fields map.

If you can produce an updated quote (Variant A) reflecting a 1.5% discount on quarterly invoices for Net-45, we can expedite sign-off. If Net-60 is a hard requirement, we'll need to escalate internally and come back.

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
ZenMedCo

Attachment: ZenMedCo_PO_template.docx

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <procurement@zenmedco.com>
Cc: Kevin O'Neil <kevin.oneil@zenmedco.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO splitting, quarterly invoices, and net-45 terms

Elena — thank you for the quick reply and the PO template. We reviewed internally and here is our updated, final commercial position:

1) PO and invoice fields: confirmed — we will map the following fields on each invoice line: PO number, PO line, billing address, project code, master agreement reference. Your PO template maps cleanly; no changes required.

2) Invoice cadence: we will issue quarterly consolidated invoices by default with line-level PO references. We can also issue separate invoices per PO if your AP requires it — please let us know which you prefer after you review the attached sample invoice.

3) Payment terms and discount: we cannot agree to Net-60 as a standard without CFO approval. As a compromise to help your working capital, Redwood will:
   - Offer a 1.25% discount on quarterly invoices if ZenMedCo accepts Net-45 (compromise between your 1.5% ask and our internal discount bands).
   - Offer 5% discount for annual committed prepay (same as previously noted).

4) PO counts: we can accept up to 6 active POs per subscription per fiscal year. For any additional POs we can use project codes for reconciliation.

Attachments: 20261205-zenmedco-quote.pdf (updated quote reflecting 1.25% discount on quarterly Net-45 billing), sample invoice (RWI-invoice-template-zenmedco.pdf)

Next steps:
- If you accept the Net-45 + 1.25% compromise, I'll send the updated quote via DocuSign and provide our W-9 and COI for vendor setup.
- If Net-60 is non-negotiable, please indicate and we'll escalate to finance/CFO for review (this will add a short delay).

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you'd prefer to finalize quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/XYZ-zenmedco-quote
Drive (updated quote): https://drive.redwood.com/zenmedco/quotes/20261205
